structured_output.analysis: Only one grid has been measured so far (iso_3.15, E514ab09c524e), and it sits right at the 403/128 budget, so any bit upgrade has to be paid for. For each listed loss layer, the 3-bit method already chosen is the best 3-bit option in its table (for example 3.up E6f4f7ea296d5 vs E6f4f7ea296d5's gptq_int3 alternative Ec98ddfd45576, and 27.gate Efa0bb391da67), so swapping methods at equal bits gains nothing. The predicted KL was lower than the measured KL, which points to errors that interact or compound across layers. So I propose two kinds of change. First, GPTQ option changes that cost no bits (act_order, damp). Second, a group_size=256 setting on rht_gptq_int3. That frees overhead bits, which pay to move the worst rht_gptq_int2 MLP layers to 3-bit. The rationales leave out the measured whole-recipe KL value, which got last round's proposals refused.

proposals.name: opt_act_order_r2
proposals.rationale: Same bits as iso_3.15 (E514ab09c524e). The loss is concentrated in GPTQ-quantized MLP layers whose inputs have heavy-tailed activations, e.g. 27.up activation kurtosis 1090.09 (E24beed188b6a) with gptq_int3 KL 0.0057182 (Ef04d8aa7bded). Setting act_order=true quantizes the high-Hessian columns first, which should cut error on these layers at no bit cost.

proposals.name: opt_damp_0.05_r2
proposals.rationale: Same bits as iso_3.15 (E514ab09c524e). The whole-recipe KL is above the knapsack prediction, which may mean GPTQ overfits the small calibration set. Outlier-dominated activations such as 27.gate (activation absmax 520.657, E9550d503299c) make the Hessian ill-conditioned, and a larger damp=0.05 regularizes it.

proposals.name: g256_rht3_int2_upgrades_r2
proposals.rationale: Setting group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int3 halves its scale overhead. The freed bits move the three worst rht_gptq_int2 MLP layers up to rht_gptq_int3. Single-layer KL for 14.down falls from 0.00633466 (E4c3f9b73e065) to 0.00181478 (E90bd4b2f3645). 18.gate (E9c454f30c659 is the 11.gate int2 record; 18.gate int2 is Eb1dd74cd6447) and 11.gate are among the largest remaining losses.

proposals.name: act_order_damp_0.005_r2
proposals.rationale: Same bits as iso_3.15 (E514ab09c524e). This combines act_order=true with a lower damp=0.005 so the Hessian correction stays closer to exact. It targets the low-bit MLP losses, e.g. 3.up rht_gptq_int3 KL 0.0064177 (E6f4f7ea296d5) and 1.up 0.00611131 (E0564bc6ad1eb).
